name: dsh-doctor
description: Health check for the dsh plugins you already installed: reports which ones ship a broken package, which are pinned to a dsh version that no longer exists, and which run code on your machine at install time. 插件体检:检查已安装插件哪些打包坏了、哪些依赖版本已过期、哪些安装时会执行代码。

summary.en: Checks the plugins you already installed against the public registry and reports what is broken, stale, or risky.
summary.zh-CN: 拿你已装的插件去公开注册表比对，报告哪些坏了、哪些版本过期、哪些有风险。
